name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

llmConfigName.description:
If using other than the default {@link Genai.Llm.ExternalLlm.Config} for this model,
specifies the name of the config to use.

modelName.description: The name of the model to be used. May be a path to a local model, a huggingface model name,

userFriendlyName.description: Get the user friendly name for the LLM instance. This will be used in the UI.

promptConfigName.description: The name of the {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.ModelInference.Prompt.Config} that should be used.

tokenizerName.description:
The name of the tokenizer to be used. Default is None. May be a path to a local tokenizer or a
hugginface tokenizer. If not provided, model_name is used to specify the tokenizer.
Not used for API-based and hosted models.

contextLength.description:
The max length of the input and generated sequence tokens. This is to be set based on model specifications.
(Only used for the non-API-based models).

vllmEndpoint.description: The secret endpoint of the Hosted VLLM, only used if llmType is set to VLLM.

route.description: The model route for the model inference service (MIS) hosted models

temperature.description:
The temperature variable used for increasing randomness of predictions for the rewriting model (only used for the
API-based models for controlling determinism). The default is 0.0 (fully deterministic).

maxOutputTokens.description: The maximum number of generated sequence.

topP.description:
The threshold for the probability mass, used by the Nucleus sampling, with default 0.9. If not
using Nucleus sampling, it is ignored.

topK.description:
The parameter used for the Top_k sampling approach with default set to 5. If not using Top_k sampling,
it is ignored.

useBeamSearch.description: Whether to use beam search instead of sampling. Default is set to False.

nBeams.description: The number of beams used by Beam search sampling, default set to 5. If not using Beam search, it is ignored.

stopSequences.description:
A list of strings that is used to stop model's text generation.
Default is None. This is used for the question answering model.

lengthPenalty.description: Float that penalizes sequences based on their length. Used in beam search. Default is 1.0.

presencePenalty.description:
presence_penalty [float]: Penalizes new tokens based on whether they appear in the generated text so far.
Values > 0 encourage the model to use new tokens, while values < 0 encourage the model to repeat tokens.
The default value is 0.0.

frequencyPenalty.description:
frequency_penalty [float]: Penalizes new tokens based on their frequency in the generated text so far.
Values > 0 encourage the model to use new tokens, while values < 0 encourage the model to repeat tokens.
The default value is 0.0.

streamResponse.description: Whether to have a streaming output. Default is set to False.

truncatePromptTotally.description:
When the prompt needs to be truncated to fit the context size, whether to remove the entire prompt
or trim it so that it fits given the number of available tokens.

apiVersion.description: The API version to be used for the LLM. Currently, only applicable for AWS Bedrock Claude 3 models.

llmType.description: The type of llm pipe to use.

uiOptions.description: Configuration for how this will be shown as a UI drop-down option.

title: Defines the specification used for running inference.
name: Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.ModelInferenceConfig
